title: design-run
description: Fail-loud state for one design run. A gate exits ONLY via pass or overridden(reason); a halted gate blocks ship. No silent degradation.

brand_kit.description: path to the active brand-kit profile; required, never defaulted

references.description: exemplar reference screenshots/URLs fed to the builder + floor rubric. COUNTED, not documentation: `gate --name references --status pass` is refused below 3, and ship-check/done re-verify the count. Write via `run_state.py references --add`; local paths must exist.

base_sha.description: target-repo git HEAD at init; baseline for the drawing_check git-diff. null if the target is not a git repo

vendored.description: files/dirs written by component-library installs; drawing_check exempts these (sanctioned copy-paste svg/canvas, not hand-drawing)

picked_candidate.description: which candidate the human chose; written only by `run_state.py pick`, the sole way to resolve human_pick. Must be in the built slate; ship-check and done re-verify.

candidates.description: the CURRENT slate the human chooses from, written only by `run_state.py candidate`. Before a direction: cheap candidates (>=3, <=4, >=2 sources, >=2 archetypes, no shared source+archetype pair) or `direction --candidate` refuses. After a direction: built candidates (<=4); a built candidate is refused before a direction exists.

source.description: the well: a library (aceternity, magicui, shadcn, heroui, 21st), mcp-image, brand-asset, type-only

archetype.description: e.g. type-led, photo-led, motion-led, component-grid, generated-imagery

direction.description: the direction being built: the human's pick from a cheap slate (candidate + the slate snapshot) or the direction the human named up front (given). null until chosen; `pick` refuses without one.
